related_questions.question: What is the new policy for Southwest Airlines?

text_blocks.snippet: Southwest Airlines is undergoing significant policy changes, including the introduction of assigned seating, new fare products, and changes to baggage policies. These changes are being rolled out in phases, with some already in effect and others coming later this year and into 2026.
snippet_highlighted_words: introduction of assigned seating, new fare products, and changes to baggage policies

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a breakdown of the key changes:

list.snippet: Southwest will transition to assigned seating, a major departure from its previous open seating policy.
This is expected to be available for flights in the second half of 2025 for travel in 2026.
New fare options, including Standard, Preferred, and Extra Legroom, will be available, allowing customers to select their preferred seat.
Basic, Wanna Get Away Plus®, and Anytime fares will have checked baggage fees, while Business Select® fares will continue to include two free checked bags.
Rapid Rewards A-List Preferred members will receive their first and second checked bags free, while A-List members and Rapid Rewards Credit Card holders will receive their first checked bag free.
Southwest is introducing new fare products with updated names and benefits, aligning with the introduction of assigned and premium seating.
Basic fares will launch on May 28, 2025, and other new fare products will launch in Q3.
Checked baggage fees will apply to Basic, Wanna Get Away Plus®, and Anytime fares booked and ticketed on or after May 28, 2025, according to Southwest Airlines.
Business Select® fares will continue to include two free checked bags.
Flight credits, previously issued with no expiration date, will now have expiration dates for those issued on or after May 28, 2025, according to LiveNOW from FOX.
EarlyBird Check-In will be available for Anytime fares purchased at least 36 hours before departure, providing an earlier boarding position.
Southwest is also expanding its Rapid Rewards program and introducing international partnerships.
